feature.name: Reduce the toughness of creatures opponents control to 0

notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 3.
description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
Apply the Academy Manufactor replacement effect then apply Chatterfang's, creating a Treasure token, a Food token, a Clue token and three 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Repeat steps 1 and 2 one additional time.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Activate a Food by paying {2}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to gain 3 life.
Repeat.
Once you have an arbitrarily high amount of life, you may repeat the loop without sacrificing Treasure or Food tokens, amassing infinite tokens of each variety.
You may also activate Chatterfang any number of times to reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Food, adding {C}{C}.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating a tapped Treasure artifact token, a tapped Clue artifact token and a tapped Food artifact token.
Repeat.

feature.name: Reduce the toughness of creatures opponents control to 0

description:
Activate Chatterfang by paying {B} and sacrificing a Squirrel.
Because the Squirrel is a Food due to Ygra, when it dies, Camellia and Ygra trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Camellia trigger, creating five 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens, a Food, a Clue and a Treasure token
Resolve the Chatterfang ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
notes: You can target Ygra with Chatterfang's ability infinitely. Since it gets +2/+2 each loop, it won't die from its toughness reduction.

feature.name: Infinite +1/+1 counters on an infinite number of creature tokens
Infinite +1/+1 counters on Squirrels you control

description:
Activate Camellia by paying {2} and sacrificing a Food.
Camellia's first ability triggers, creating two Foods, two Clues, two Treasures and two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Resolve the Camellia ability, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other Squirrel you control.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.
notes: You can replace step 1 with using the Food's own ability to sacrifice it.

feature.name: Infinite +1/+1 counters on an infinite number of creature tokens
Infinite +1/+1 counters on Squirrels you control

description:
Activate Camellia by paying {2} and sacrificing a Food.
Camellia's first ability triggers, creating a Foods, a Clue, a Treasure and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the Camellia ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other Squirrel you control.
Activate two of the artifact tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.
notes: You can sacrifice the Foods to their own abilities instead - you will simply tap the Clue and Treasure for mana instead.

notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Cauldron Familiar, creating a Food, Treasure and Clue token.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
description:
Activate a Food using Pippin's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a Food, Clue and Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

Activate Nuka-Cola Vending Machine by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a Food, Clue and Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Food and Clue, untapping Nuka-Cola Vending Machine.
Repeat.

notablePrerequisites: You control at least one other Food that does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate a Food using Gilded Goose's first ability by paying {1}{G} and tapping it, creating a Food, Clue and Treasure token.
Activate two of the artifact tokens using Gilded Goose's second ability by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar
When Cauldron Familar dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Food, a Clue, and a Treasure token.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

notablePrerequisites:
Tivit does not have summoning sickness.
Tivit cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent with Tivit.
Tivit triggers, creating at least three Food, three Clue, and three Treasure tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five artifacts, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

feature.name: Infinite mana artifacts you control can produce
Infinite untap of artifacts you control

description:
Activate Transmutation Font's first ability by tapping it, creating a Clue, a Food and a Treasure artifact token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two of the tokens, untapping Transmutation Font.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tokens, you may produce Blood tokens using Transmutation Font instead.

Activate a Food by paying {2}, tapping and sacrificing it.
Camellia triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token, a Food token, a Clue token and a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2, as the Treasure is a Food due to Gourmand's Talent.

notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to kill a creature.
There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Mirkwood Bats triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Kill the Smaug token, triggering its ability creating fourteen Treasure, fourteen Clue and fourteen Food tokens.
Mirkwood Bats triggers 42 times, causing each opponent to lose 42 life.
If desired, activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding fourteen mana of any color(s).
If you sacrificed the Treasures, Mirkwood Bats triggers fourteen times, causing each opponent to lose 14 life.

Activate a Food by paying {1} due to Sam, tapping and sacrificing it.
Camellia triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a Food, Clue and Treasure token due to Peregrin Took and Academy Manufactor.
Resolve the Food ability, causing you to gain 3 life.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

feature.name: Destroy each creature that enters the battlefield under an opponent's control

notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Foods.
description:
Activate Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar by sacrificing two Foods, targeting any creature.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers twice, creating two tapped Food, two tapped Clue and two tapped Treasure tokens.
Repeat as desired.
Resolve all Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar abilities, causing any number of creatures to deal infinite damage to themselves.
You may repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Lonis.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, creating a Clue, a Food, and a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

Activate Witch's Oven by tapping it and sacrificing Cauldron Familiar, creating a Clue token, a Food token, and a Treasure token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two artifact tokens, untapping Witch's Oven.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food token, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Pirates that do not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by at least two opponents.
description:
Deal combat damage to two opponents using at least two Pirates.
Malcolm triggers, creating at least two Treasure, Food and Clue tokens.
Activate TIme Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
notes: Once you only have one opponent remaining, this combo will no longer make the necessary resources to sustain itself.

description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {1}.
Forensic Gadgeteer triggers, creating a Clue, a Food and a Treasure artifact token.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield on top of your library.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping two of the artifact tokens, adding {U}{U}.
Activate the Clue by paying {1} and sacrificing it, causing you to draw Sensei's  Divining Top from the top of your library.
Repeat.

Activate The Underworld Cookbook's first ability by tapping it and discarding Ovalchase Daredevil, creating a Food token, a Clue token, and a Treasure tokens.
The three tokens enter the battlefield, triggering Ovalchase Daredevil that many times, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two artifact tokens, untapping The Underworld Cookbook.
Repeat.

notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by at least one opponent.
description:
Attack with a creatue you control.
When that creature deals combat damage to an opponent, Grim Hireling triggers.
Resolve the Grim Hireling trigger, creating two Treasure tokens, two Food tokens, and two Clue tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by sacrificing five of the created artifacts and tapping it to take an extra turn.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.

Cast Gingerbrute by paying {1}.
When Gingerbrute enters the battlefield, Samwise triggers, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
Activate the two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Activate Samwise by sacrificing Gingerbrute and the two Foods, returning Syr Ginger to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Syr Ginger by paying {2}.
When Syr Ginger enters the battlefield, Samwise triggers, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Activate Samwise by sacrificing Syr Ginger and the two Foods, returning Gingerbrute to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Prosperous Partnership by tapping three creatures you control, creating either three 2/2 Cat or 3/1 Dog creature tokens.
Repeat.

notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Treasure token.
description:
Activate Stimulus Package by sacrificing a Treasure, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token as well as a Food, Clue and Treasure artifact token.
Repeat.

notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control another creature.
description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Food, Clue and Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Activate the Food by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it.
Experimental Confectioner triggers, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the Food ability, causing you to gain 3 life.
Repeat.

At the beginning of your end step, Soulherder's second ability triggers, blinking Wernog.
When Wernog leaves and enters the battlefield, it triggers twice and Soulherder's first ability triggers once.
Resolve both Wernog triggers, creating at least two Clue, two Food and two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Soulherder trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five artifacts, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Wernog.
When Wernog leaves and enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve both triggers, creating at least two Clue, two Food and two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five artifacts, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

manaNeeded: {2}{G}{W} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
description:
Cast Farmer Cotton either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{G}{W} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Farmer Cotton enters the battlefield, it and Samwise trigger.
Resolve the Farmer Cotton trigger, creating two 1/1 Halfling creature tokens and two Food, two Clue and two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Samwise trigger, creating a Food, a Clue and a Treasure artifact token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Farmer Cotton, adding {C}{C}.
If Farmer Cotton is your commander, choose not to return it to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Samwise by sacrificing the three Foods, returning Farmer Cotton to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {G}{W}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasure tokens, you may sacrifice them to get infinite colored mana, which can be used to cast Farmer Cotton for an arbitrarily large amount of mana to create infinite Food tokens.

At the beginning of your upkeep, Tamiyo's Journal triggers, creating two Food, two Clue, and two Treasure tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five artifacts, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

At the beginning of your upkeep, Tamiyo's Journal triggers, creating two Food, two Clue, and two Treasure tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five artifacts, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Wernog.
When Wernog leaves and enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve both triggers, creating at least two Clue, two Food and two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five artifacts, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with another creature.
description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself.
Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, triggering its soulbond ability and Lonis.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, creating a Clue, a Food, and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it and any other creature.
Activate the Food or Clue token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with another creature.
description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself.
Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, triggering its soulbond ability and Lonis.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, creating two Clue, two Food, and two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it and any other creature.
Activate the two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

Activate Wernog by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Wernog leaves and enters, triggering it twice and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability once.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it and Wernog.
Resolve both Wernog triggers, causing you to create at least two Clue, two Food, and two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Academy Manufactor.
When Academy Manufactor enters the battlefield, Samwise Gamgee triggers, creating a Food, a Clue, and a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Food, Clue and Treasure tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

notablePrerequisites: You have at least one card in hand.
description:
Activate The Underworld Cookbook's first ability by discarding a card and tapping it, creating a Food, Clue and Treasure artifact token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Food and Treasure, untapping The Underworld Cookbook.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing either the Food or the Treasure, adding {C}{C}.
Activate the Clue token by paying {2} and tapping it, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token as well as a Food, a Clue and a Treasure artifact token.
Activate two of the artifact tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

feature.name: Infinite copies of artifacts you control
Infinite copies of artifacts you control with haste

notablePrerequisites: You control a Food, Clue or Treasure.
description:
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, targeting a Food, Treasure or Clue you control, but creating one of each due to Academy Manufactor.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Food, Treasure and Clue, adding six {C}.
Repeat.
notes: As mana allows, you can skip step 2.

feature.name: Cast all spells in your library

notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with another creature.
description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself.
Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, triggering its soulbond ability and Lonis.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, creating a Clue, a Food, and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it and any other creature.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping two artifacts, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's second ability to cast all cards in your library.

At the beginning of your end step, Thassa triggers, blinking Wernog.
When Wernog leaves and enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve both triggers, creating at least two Clue, two Food and two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five artifacts, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Gilded Goose.
Gilded Goose enters the battlefield, creating a Food, a Clue, and a Treasure token.
Activate the Food, Clue and Treasure tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

feature.name: Near-infinite untap of artifacts you control

description:
Activate Collector's Vault by paying {2} and tapping it, causing you to loot and create a Food, a Clue and a Treasure artifact token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two of the artifact tokens, untapping Collector's Vault.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing an artifact token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

Cast Gingerbrute by paying {1}.
When Gingerbrute enters the battlefield, Samwise triggers, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
Activate the two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Activate Samwise by sacrificing Gingerbrute and the two Foods, returning Syr Ginger to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Syr Ginger by paying {2}.
When Syr Ginger enters the battlefield, Samwise triggers, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Activate Samwise by sacrificing Syr Ginger and the two Foods, returning Gingerbrute to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

Cast Essence Flux by paying {U}, blinking Eternal Witness.
Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Lonis.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Essence Flux from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, creating a Food, a Clue, and a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

Cast Gingerbrute by paying {1}.
When Gingerbrute enters the battlefield, Samwise triggers, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
Activate the two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Activate Samwise by sacrificing Gingerbrute and the two Foods, returning Syr Ginger to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Syr Ginger by paying {2}.
When Syr Ginger enters the battlefield, Samwise triggers, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Activate Samwise by sacrificing Syr Ginger and the two Foods, returning Gingerbrute to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

Activate Coin of Mastery by tapping it, creating a Food, Clue and Treasure token due to Academy Manufactor.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two tokens, untapping Coin of Mastery.
Repeat.

manaNeeded: {2}{G}{W} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
description:
Cast Farmer Cotton either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{G}{W} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Farmer Cotton enters the battlefield, it and Samwise trigger.
Resolve the Farmer Cotton trigger, creating two 1/1 Halfling creature tokens and two Food, two Clue and two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Samwise trigger, creating a Food, a Clue and a Treasure artifact token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Farmer Cotton, adding {G}.
If Farmer Cotton is your commander, choose not to return it to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Samwise by sacrificing the three Foods, returning Farmer Cotton to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{W}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Halfling, adding {1}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasure tokens, you may sacrifice them to get infinite colored mana, which can be used to cast Farmer Cotton for an arbitrarily large amount of mana to create infinite Food tokens.

Cast Gingerbrute by paying {1}.
When Gingerbrute enters the battlefield, Samwise triggers, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
Activate the two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Activate Samwise by sacrificing Gingerbrute and the two Foods, returning Syr Ginger to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Syr Ginger by paying {2}.
When Syr Ginger enters the battlefield, Samwise triggers, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Activate Samwise by sacrificing Syr Ginger and the two Foods, returning Gingerbrute to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

feature.name: Infinite mana artifacts you control can produce
Infinite untap of artifacts you control

description:
Activate Tree of Tales by tapping it, creating a Food, a Clue, and a Treasure artifact token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two artifact tokens, untapping Tree of Tales.
Repeat.
